_note: Primary source: Branch Staff FAQ Document + UPDATED - SOCIAL MEDIA RESPONSE TEMPLATE 12.08.2025 (source='docs'). A few fields (address wording, phone numbers) are cross-checked against the Bank of Zambia's Nov 2025 branch-network filing (source='boz') where the two priority docs were silent or slightly worded differently — noted per-branch. 'verified: false' means a human still needs to confirm before this reaches a customer, even where a figure/address is present. Ops must resolve the branch-count discrepancy noted below before launch.
_discrepancy_note: The Social Media Response Template's intro line says AB Bank has '9 branches and 1 satellite branch' (as of 12 Aug 2025), but the same document's own branch/sort-code listing plus the Branch Staff FAQ enumerate 10 full branches (Cairo, Acacia Premium/Head Office, Chilenje, Matero, Kalingalinga, Chelston, Kitwe, Ndola, Chipata, Solwezi) plus 1 satellite (Mumbwa) = 11 locations. The Bank of Zambia's Nov 2025 filing lists a 12th location (Chongwe, a promotional office) not present in either priority document at all. Likely explanation: Solwezi and/or Chongwe opened after the '9+1' headline figure was last updated. Do not quote a branch count to customers until ops confirms the current total.
